profile.name: Raf
profile.intro: Aspiring full-stack developer who designs, builds, and deploys complete web apps on my own — from the MySQL schema and REST API to a React front end people can actually use.
profile.photoAlt: Portrait of Rafael Vincent D. Medina

paragraphs: I’m a developer who learns by building. Every project on this site started as a real problem — tracking intern hours, managing car rentals, archiving theses — and I took each one from blank folder to live deployment on my own.

Most of my work is on the web: React and TypeScript on the front, PHP and MySQL behind it, connected through REST APIs. Building solo means I’ve handled every layer myself — database design, authentication, file uploads, PDF generation, email, and hosting.
I’m now looking for my first developer role, where I can learn from a team and keep shipping.

projects.title: Thesis Archive System
projects.description:
Our college stored research papers manually. As my thesis project, I built a searchable online archive for the College and Senior High School departments.

Students submit theses with abstracts, authors, advisors and PDFs, then track approval status. Admins and student assistants review submissions and manage programs, users and site branding. Visitors can search by title, author or abstract, filter by program and year, and read PDFs in the browser.

projects.title: DTR for Internship
projects.description: DTR System is a web-based Daily Time Record application built for interns to track their daily attendance and rendered hours. Users can register, log in, and record their AM/PM time-in and time-out, including half-day entries. The system automatically computes hours worked and undertime, shows a dashboard with weekly and total hours, and keeps a monthly attendance history with remarks. Users can download their monthly DTR as a printable PDF and reset forgotten passwords by email.

projects.title: Lord of the Rims
projects.description:
Lord of the Rims is a full-stack car rental web app built as my PHP final project.

Customers can browse and filter a fleet of luxury vehicles, sign up for an account, and book a car using an interactive calendar that greys out dates already taken. Each booking calculates its total price automatically, and customers can track or cancel their reservations from a "My Bookings" page.

Admins get a dedicated dashboard with live stats (fleet size, bookings, revenue and customers), can add or edit vehicles with photo uploads, and move bookings through each stage from pending to confirmed, active and completed.
